MA01.text: Welcome to your little corner of Heaven. Follow the glowing trail to gather the Waycoins, then the gem. We’ll turn them into a brave little defense.
MA01.speaker: angel

MA02.text: Your Coin Pup is already gathering our supplies. Let that helpful little nose collect the coins and gem; then we’ll put them to good use.
MA02.speaker: angel

MA03.text: Now, let’s build your first defense. Use Buy Egg to create five Earth Eggs. There’s a whole little squad waiting to begin.
MA03.speaker: angel

MA04.text: Lovely. Choose Deploy Best, and your eggs will take their places on the defense line. Your little guardians can handle the first arrivals.
MA04.speaker: angel

MA05.text: Before we strengthen the line, gather a Waycoin pile. The engineer needs a little funding to bring his work to life.
MA05.speaker: angel

MA06.text: Our engineer has arrived at the gold line. Follow the guide and speak with him. A sturdy defense can give every guardian a little more time.
MA06.speaker: angel

MA07.text: Unlock the Impaler Palisade with your gem. Those sharp little points will help your new wall stand up to trouble.
MA07.speaker: angel

MA08.text: Now choose Install. There—another layer of protection for your brave little defenders. We’re building something worth holding onto.
MA08.speaker: angel

MA09.text: Gather a Waycoin pile for the next improvement. A little support from the artillery commander will help your line last longer.
MA09.speaker: angel

MA10.text: Follow the guide to the gem. Keep it close; it will unlock a cannon that helps mend your defense.
MA10.speaker: angel

MA11.text: The artillery commander is ready at the right-hand gun. Follow the guide and speak with him. Even the strongest line deserves a little care.
MA11.speaker: angel

MA12.text: Choose Unlock for the Heal cannon. Your gem will open a gentler kind of artillery—one that helps keep your defense standing.
MA12.speaker: angel

MA13.text: Choose Install, and let the Heal cannon join your defense. A little kindness in the right place can make a wonderful difference.
MA13.speaker: angel

MA14.text: You’ve earned a new power. Open Powers and choose one, then Commit. Magnet is a helpful first choice for bringing scattered loot a little closer.
MA14.speaker: angel

MA15.text: Let’s gather a few more Waycoins for your eggs. Follow the guide; a stronger line begins with one small improvement at a time.
MA15.speaker: angel

MA16.text: Your Coin Pup will gather what we need. Give that faithful little helper a moment, and we’ll improve your defense together.
MA16.speaker: angel

MA17.text: Let’s give your line a little more strength. Buy a couple of eggs, then use Deploy Best. If you already have an egg, placing it works too.
MA17.speaker: angel

MA18.text: Your eggs are ready. Choose Deploy Best to combine matching eggs or place one on the line. Either is a good next step.
MA18.speaker: angel

MA19.text: Let’s make room for your powers to grow. In Powers, choose two extra enhancement slots, then Commit. You can change your picks before committing.
MA19.speaker: angel

MA20.text: Now we can give a power a little more sparkle. Choose it in Powers, and let’s fit an enhancement into one of its slots.
MA20.speaker: angel

MA21.text: Meet Macros, your Quartermaster. He has boosts, enhancements, and optional training whenever you want them. There’s no need to visit right now; your adventure is yours.
MA21.speaker: angel

MA22.text: Your guardians are ready. Try spreading your defense across more hatchers; two smaller squads can serve you better than one powerful egg. It’s your choice.
MA22.speaker: angel

MA23.text: Your wall is in place. Let’s see how the line holds now. Each small improvement gives your guardians a little more breathing room.
MA23.speaker: angel

MA24.text: Your Heal cannon is ready. Keep the defense going; there’s a new power waiting a little further along.
MA24.speaker: angel

MA25.text: That power is yours now. Try it when it will help, and keep your defense growing. You’re finding your own way.
MA25.speaker: angel

MA26.text: That’s a little stronger already. Let your guardians get back to work. You can keep improving the line as you go.
MA26.speaker: angel

MA27.text: Your extra slots are ready. Keep the line steady, and soon we’ll give one of your powers a useful enhancement.
MA27.speaker: angel

MA28.text: There—that power has a little more to offer. Keep going; you’ve nearly learned everything you need to manage this defense yourself.
MA28.speaker: angel

MA29.text: You’ve learned the essentials, little light. Keep growing your defense, explore when you wish, and remember: you can always take a breather in Farm and Fight.
MA29.speaker: angel

MA30.text: Welcome back, little light. Your progress is still here. Follow the guide, and we’ll pick up with the step you were working on.
MA30.speaker: angel

MA31.condition: Recurring idle encouragement during required hands-on lessons
MA31.text: Whenever you’re ready, little light, the glowing guide will show your next step. Take your time. We’ll build this together.
MA31.speaker: angel

MA32.text: Magnet is a helpful beginning. Choose the power you want, then Commit when you’re happy with your choice.
MA32.speaker: angel

MA33.text: Choose two extra slots on powers you own. You can put them where they’ll help most, and change your picks before you Commit.
MA33.speaker: angel

MA34.text: Your choices are ready. Choose Commit to make them yours, or adjust them first if something doesn’t feel right.
MA34.speaker: angel

MA35.condition: Choose an owned power to enhance
MA35.text: Choose one of your powers. Then we can look at its slots and find a home for that enhancement.
MA35.speaker: angel

MA36.text: Choose an empty enhancement slot on that power. A small space, with room for something helpful.
MA36.speaker: angel

MA38.text: That looks ready. Choose Apply to place the enhancement into your power. Then let’s see what it can do.
MA38.speaker: angel

MA39.condition: Origin choice encountered during low-level power guidance
MA39.text: This choice shapes the powers you can learn. Take a moment to explore the origins, and choose the one that feels right for you.
MA39.speaker: angel

MA40.text: Take one last look before you confirm. Your origin is a permanent choice, so choose the path you truly want to follow.
MA40.speaker: angel

MD01.text: So, this patch of Hell is yours. Collect the Waycoins along the glowing trail, then the gem. Even impending disaster needs a starting budget.
MD01.speaker: demon

MD02.text: You brought a Coin Pup. Delegating already? Sensible. Let it collect the coins and gem while you practice looking like you’re in charge.
MD02.speaker: demon

MD03.text: Five Earth Eggs. Use Buy Egg until you have them. Yes, eggs. Apparently that is what stands between you and utter embarrassment.
MD03.speaker: demon

MD04.text: Choose Deploy Best. It puts those eggs to work on your defense line. They cannot defend much while you leave them admiring the board.
MD04.speaker: demon

MD05.text: Fetch a Waycoin pile. The engineer does not accept hopeful expressions as payment. I asked.
MD05.speaker: demon

MD06.text: The engineer is waiting at the gold line. Go speak with him. A wall might compensate for that optimistic approach to survival.
MD06.speaker: demon

MD07.text: Unlock the Impaler Palisade. One gem buys a rather pointed objection to trespassers. Finally, a decorating choice I approve of.
MD07.speaker: demon

MD08.text: Choose Install. Owning a wall and actually putting it in the enemy’s way are, regrettably, different things.
MD08.speaker: demon

MD09.text: Another Waycoin pile, please. Artillery is wonderfully persuasive, but apparently persuasion has installation costs.
MD09.speaker: demon

MD10.text: Collect that gem. We’re unlocking a Heal cannon. Try not to look so disappointed that it does something useful.
MD10.speaker: demon

MD11.text: Your artillery commander is waiting by the right-hand gun. Go introduce yourself before your defense introduces itself to the floor.
MD11.speaker: demon

MD12.text: Unlock Heal with your gem. Yes, healing artillery. Apparently keeping your defenders alive is part of the strategy.
MD12.speaker: demon

MD13.text: Choose Install. Let the Heal cannon earn its place. Your defenders have been very patient with your management so far.
MD13.speaker: demon

MD14.text: You’ve earned a power. Open Powers, choose one, and Commit. Magnet can collect scattered loot. Anything that reduces your wandering is progress.
MD14.speaker: demon

MD15.text: Gather some more Waycoins. Your eggs could use an improvement, and glaring at them has achieved remarkably little.
MD15.speaker: demon

MD16.text: Let your Coin Pup gather the funds. At least one member of this operation understands the assignment.
MD16.speaker: demon

MD17.text: Time to improve those eggs. Buy a couple, then use Deploy Best. Already have one waiting? Place it. I’m mocking you, not trying to trap you.
MD17.speaker: demon

MD18.text: Choose Deploy Best. It can combine matching eggs or place one on the line. Either counts. Do try to contain your relief.
MD18.speaker: demon

MD19.text: Two extra enhancement slots are yours to choose. Open Powers, place them, and Commit. You may reconsider before committing. A rare luxury.
MD19.speaker: demon

MD20.text: Those new slots are not merely decorative. Choose a power in Powers, and fit it with an enhancement. Let’s see some improvement.
MD20.speaker: demon

MD21.text: That’s Macros, your Quartermaster. Boosts, enhancements, optional training. Visit when you like. For once, I am not giving you homework.
MD21.speaker: demon

MD22.text: Eggs in one basket? How traditional. Try filling another hatcher; two smaller squads can serve you better than one powerful egg. Your defense, your decision.
MD22.speaker: demon

MD23.text: A wall, installed correctly. I shall try not to sound surprised. Let the next enemies test your handiwork.
MD23.speaker: demon

MD24.text: The Heal cannon is installed. Let’s see whether your defense survives long enough to earn its next lesson.
MD24.speaker: demon

MD25.text: A power of your own. Use it when it helps. I’d hate for it to become another expensive ornament.
MD25.speaker: demon

MD26.text: An improvement. I noticed. Your guardians may return to work while I recover from this unexpected competence.
MD26.speaker: demon

MD27.text: Your slots are ready. Hold the line a little longer, and we’ll put something useful in one of them.
MD27.speaker: demon

MD28.text: An enhanced power. Better. Keep the defense going. You are becoming inconveniently capable.
MD28.speaker: demon

MD29.text: That concludes your introduction to barely controlled chaos. Keep improving your defense. Explore if you like. You may even visit Farm and Fight. I shall endure your absence.
MD29.speaker: demon

MD30.text: Back for more? Your progress survived. Follow the guide, and we’ll resume the part you were so thoughtfully contemplating.
MD30.speaker: demon

MD31.condition: Recurring idle encouragement during required hands-on lessons
MD31.text: Your next step is still waiting by the glowing guide. No rush. The enemies have only their entire existence to spare.
MD31.speaker: demon

MD32.text: Choose a power, then Commit. Magnet is useful. So, I’m told, is making a decision.
MD32.speaker: demon

MD33.text: Place your extra slots on powers you own. Change your picks if you must, then Commit. Empty deliberation is not an enhancement.
MD33.speaker: demon

MD34.text: Your choices are waiting. Commit to keep them, or adjust them first. Staring at the button is not a third option.
MD34.speaker: demon

MD35.condition: Choose an owned power to enhance
MD35.text: Choose a power you own. We need somewhere to put the enhancement, preferably somewhere useful.
MD35.speaker: demon

MD36.text: Choose an empty slot on that power. Yes, the empty one. We’re filling it, not admiring it.
MD36.speaker: demon

MD38.text: Choose Apply. The enhancement does rather more inside the power than it does sitting in a menu.
MD38.speaker: demon

MD39.condition: Origin choice encountered during low-level power guidance
MD39.text: Choosing an origin? That shapes the powers you can learn. Read the choices. Even I would not rush you through this one.
MD39.speaker: demon

MD40.text: One last look before you confirm. Your origin is permanent. For this decision, thinking twice is entirely acceptable.
MD40.speaker: demon

MA37.text: Choose an enhancement that fits your power. A Focus enhancement can help it use less of your energy.
MA37.speaker: angel

MD37.text: Choose a fitting enhancement. Focus reduces the energy your power spends. Efficiency. Such a refreshing concept.
MD37.speaker: demon
